result.stdout:
Open an airlock into a disposable Windows Sandbox and work in it. The projects you open are the only writable folders on your machine.

Usage:
  airlock [verb...] [--help, -h, -?] [--project, -p:<value>] [--dry-run]

Arguments:
  verb                   open | start | stop | list | create | remove | tools | connect

Switches:
  --help, -h, -?         show this help
  --project, -p:<value>  the folder to open; defaults to the current directory
  --dry-run              show what would be mounted and exit without starting anything

Examples:
  airlock start
      bring the sandbox up with everything configured, and show it
  airlock open claude
      open this folder as an airlock and start Claude in it
  airlock open
      open this folder as an airlock and get a shell in it
  airlock --project:S:\src\Foo open
      open a folder other than this one
  airlock tools add S:\bin\mytools
      mount a folder read-only onto the PATH
  airlock list
      every airlock, and whether it is open right now

Commands:
  open     open this folder as an airlock and run a tool in it, or a shell
  start    bring the sandbox up with every configured tool and airlock
  stop     destroy the sandbox; --force stops one it cannot prove is its own
  list     every airlock, and whether it is open right now
  create   register a folder as an airlock without opening it
  remove   unregister one by name or folder; it stays mounted until stop
  tools    list, add or remove the read-only mounts that land on PATH
  connect  reopen the sandbox desktop window

result.stdout:
Open this folder as an airlock and run a tool in it - or a shell, given none.

Usage:
  airlock open [tool...] [--help, -h, -?]

Arguments:
  tool            the tool to run, and its arguments

Switches:
  --help, -h, -?  show this help

Examples:
  airlock open
      open this folder and get a shell in it
  airlock open claude
      open this folder and start Claude in it
  airlock open claude --resume
      anything after the tool belongs to the tool
  airlock --project:S:\src\Foo open
      open a folder other than this one

result.stdout:
Destroy the sandbox and detach every airlock mounted in it.

Usage:
  airlock stop [--help, -h, -?] [--force]

Switches:
  --help, -h, -?  show this help
  --force         stop a sandbox even if Airlock cannot prove it started it

Examples:
  airlock stop
      destroy the sandbox
  airlock stop --force
      stop one Airlock cannot prove it started
